title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This process ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Regression Coefficients
text: When you mean-center the data, the intercept term is not affected, but the other coefficients might change. However, the relationship between the predictors and the response remains the same.

title: Full Column Rank Assumption
text: The assumption that both X and X~ have full column rank implies that there are no perfect multicollinearities among the predictors, allowing for unique solutions for the regression coefficients.
